locations.name: City of Surrey Truck Parking (17768 96 Avenue)
locations.source_note: City of Surrey commercial truck parking site at 17768 96 Avenue (Anniedale-Tynehead), Hwy 15 / Pacific Highway corridor. City news and corporate reports advance this City-owned lot (~41 truck spaces) under Temporary Use Permit / licence with Prudential Transportation. Pin matches the Phase A Surrey stand-in coordinates. Retyped from company_yard to truck_parking (ALCAN public lot class).

locations.name: DP World Fraser Surrey Docks
locations.source_note: DP World Fraser Surrey container, steel and lumber terminal at 11060 Elevator Road, Surrey BC, on the Fraser River (Port of Vancouver). Operator: https://www.dpworld.com/canada/projects/fraser-surrey; CBSA office 'Fraser Surrey Dock' https://www.cbsa-asfc.gc.ca/do-rb/offices-bureaux/320-eng.html. Pin is the centre of OSM way 1309448444 (landuse=port, 'DP World Fraser Surrey - Containers', addr 11060 Elevator Road), Overpass API (maps.mail.ru mirror) read 2026-11-22. Ships and receives: a marine terminal trucks import boxes out and export lumber and steel in.
